name: VPS & maintenance
author: Brett
description: Everything VPS in one plugin (Brett, Nov 10 2026). Status: live gauges and meters for load (1/5/15 min), RAM, swap and every filesystem, Docker per-container CPU and memory and the top processes, in four views (radial, bars, compact strip, history sparklines) with adjustable thresholds. A banner widget (icon only in a heat colour from white through gray and black to red, icon plus value, or mini meters) whose dropdown lists every gauge with its heat dot, name, percentage and values. Clean-up: (finished build worktrees, dangling Docker images and build cache, old logs and the journal, /tmp leftovers, containers stuck in Created, stopped containers, apt/npm/pip caches, old Playwright browsers, stale git locks) always preview first, then go to axHub as one held call: nothing is removed until Brett approves it, and the VPS re-checks every item before removing it. Never running containers, volumes in use or app data. Nightly auto-clean of the safe jobs (off by default), alerts at 80/85/90% disk and when swap stays nearly full (console and phone), the systems check row Server health with Auto fix, and a Server disk card for Home (server health is plain code, no AI). Clean up build profiles: audits every build profile (open builds, steps, copied tracker checklists and plans) against merged PRs, git history, reports, the catalog and the other profiles; each item gets keep / done already / not needed / duplicate / merge with a reason and proof. Preview first, untick anything, then apply: done → complete, the rest archived (never deleted), one undo per run, running builds never touched. Deep (AI) mode when a model is set up, Basic (exact matches) otherwise. Auto-cleanup over a disk threshold (off by default) sends the safe jobs for approval; every finished run goes into the fix log. The VPS tools tab gathers every other VPS feature in the console.
